blocks.text: The final onboarding step displays all the policy configurations you have selected. To make changes to any set of policies, click the Edit icon to return to that section. You can also make changes later in the Zscaler Admin Console.

Click Activate and Launch to activate Zscaler with the policies you have selected and launch the Networking dashboard in the Zscaler Admin Console. From there, you have access to all Zscaler capabilities.
To learn more, see Signing in to the Zscaler Admin Console.
